$comment: Project-specific exemptions for scripts/audit-ui.mjs. The rules live in the script and are shared; which files may break them is a property of this project. The allow-lists merge over the script's defaults, so an entry here only ever adds an exemption.

allowedColourFiles.app/foundations/page.tsx: The token reference. It prints every colour value in the theme by definition — a page that documents the palette has to contain the palette — so the colour rules cannot apply to it. This is the one file where a literal is the content rather than a decision, and it is why the exemption is scoped to this file alone rather than to `app/`.
allowedColourFiles.app/rules/page.tsx: The rule book. It publishes the semantic roles with their measured values and the contrast each one clears, which cannot be written without the values. Same reasoning as app/foundations/page.tsx.
